paper.title: BindGPT: A Scalable Framework for 3D Molecular Design via Language Modeling and Reinforcement Learning

result.summary: BindGPT 是一个将 3D 分子设计表述为文本生成的语言模型框架，联合生成分子图与构象，无需额外的图重建步骤 [abstract][S1.p5]。作者在大规模 3D 分子数据集上预训练，并用外部对接软件的评分进行强化学习微调 [abstract]。实验表明，单个预训练语言模型可同时充当 3D 分子生成模型、以分子图为条件的构象生成器以及以口袋为条件的 3D 分子生成器 [abstract]。在多个任务上，BindGPT 的表现与当前最好的专用扩散模型、语言模型和图神经网络相当或更好，而采样成本低两个数量级 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的核心问题是：如何用一个概念简单、无领域归纳偏置的生成模型，在蛋白质结合位点内生成 3D 分子，并同时覆盖多种 3D 分子生成任务 [abstract][S1.p3]。原文指出，多数空间分子生成器只关注原子类型和位置，依赖 OpenBabel 等外部工具进行键重建，而原子位置的微小调整可能显著改变重建的键甚至使分子图不连通 [S1.p2]。此外，3D 分子生成在语言模型方法中受到的关注有限 [S2.p5]。

evidence.quote: However, it’s noteworthy that most spatial molecular generators focus exclusively on atom types and locations.
They depend on supplementary tools, such as OpenBabel, for the critical task of bond reconstruction.
minor positional adjustments can significantly alter reconstructed molecular bonds or even make the molecular graph disconnected.
This entirely data-driven approach, devoid of any inductive biases at both the model and representation levels, capitalizes on the established GPT paradigm
However, the challenge of 3D molecule generation has received limited attention in language model approach.

method.text: BindGPT 的核心思想是把多种 3D 分子设计任务表述为带提示的文本生成，将条件 token 放在待生成对象 token 之前 [S3.p1]。模型采用 decoder-only 的 GPT-NeoX 架构并使用旋转位置嵌入，以支持序列长度泛化 [S3.SS1.p1]。它使用结构 SMILES 和空间 XYZ 格式描述分子图与原子位置，从而消除对外部图重建软件的依赖 [S1.p5]。训练流程包括大规模预训练、在 CrossDocked 2020 上的监督微调，以及使用对接软件反馈的强化学习微调 [S3.SS2.p1][S3.SS3.SSS1.p1][S3.SS3.SSS2.p1]。

evidence.quote: The main principle in our approach is to formulate several 3D molecular design task as prompted generation of text.
we layout the tokens of a condition before the tokens of the object to generate.
we follow the decoder-only paradigm in Language Models and use the GPT-NeoX
architecture that utilizes rotary position embeddings. This technique allows for the length generalization
It uses structural SMILES and spatial XYZ formats to describe molecular graphs and atom locations, eliminating the dependency on external software for graph reconstruction.
we use a large-scale but specialized dataset of 3D molecules and protein pockets.
During the supervised fine-tuning phase, we continue model training on CrossDocked 2020
Our main motivation to use RL after the pretraining/finetuning stages is to use the knowledge distilled into the model from massive amounts of less structured data.

experiments.text: 预训练使用 Uni-Mol 作者提出的大规模 3D 分子数据集，包含 1200 万分子的 2.08 亿个构象和 320 万个蛋白质口袋空间结构 [S4.p2]。口袋条件生成任务在 CrossDocked 数据集上微调，过滤后约有 2700 万口袋-配体对，覆盖 1.4 万分子与 3000 个口袋的交叉组合，并留出 100 个口袋用于评估 [S4.p2]。3D 分子与 3D 构象生成任务在 GEOM-DRUGS 数据集上微调，该数据集包含 30 万分子的 2700 万个构象 [S4.p2]。零样本构象生成评估使用 Platinum 数据集 [S4.p2]。强化学习使用基于 TRL 训练循环的分布式算法，8 个 GPU worker，每个本地 batch size 为 16 [A2.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: The dataset contains 208M conformations for 12M molecules and 3.2M spatial structures of protein pockets.
Our filtration of the dataset has around 27M pocket-ligand pairs covering a cross product of 14k molecules with 3k pockets
We also hold out a set of 100 pockets from the training data for evaluating the model performance.
we also finetune the model on the GEOM-DRUGS dataset, with drug-like molecules having high-quality 3D molecular conformations.
This dataset contains 27M conformations for 300k molecules
we use the Platinum dataset as a hold-out evaluation dataset to test our model and baselines on zero-shot conformer generation.
We use a distributed Reinforcement Learning algorithm based on the TRL training loop.
We use $8$ gpu workers, each with the local batch size of $16$.

findings.text: 预训练的 BindGPT 在无显式和有显式氢两种设置下均持续优于 XYZ-TF 基线，并且是首个能在如此大规模下显式建模氢的模型 [S4.SS1.p3]。在 GEOM-DRUGS 上微调后，BindGPT 在几乎所有分布评估指标上达到 state-of-the-art [S4.SS1.p3]。在 Platinum 零样本构象生成评估中，BindGPT 在 RDKit 辅助下能匹配 Torsional Diffusion 的表现，无辅助时存在小差距，而 Uni-Mol 未能泛化到该数据集 [S4.SS1.p3]。在口袋条件分子生成中，经强化学习微调的 BindGPT-RL 在结合能上显著优于此前所有最佳基线 [S4.SS2.p3]。

evidence.quote: the pretrained BindGPT model consistently outperforms the XYZ-TF baseline both without and with explicit hydrogens.
BindGPT is the first model capable of modeling hydrogen explicitly at such large scale.
BindGPT (being finetuned on this data) shows state-of-the-art performance scores for nearly all distributional evaluation metrics.
BindGPT, in contrast, is capable of matching the performance of TD when assisted by the RDKit tool and having a small gap when not.
Surprisingly, Uni-Mol fails to generalize to this new dataset (even assisted by RDKit)
the RL finetuned model can learn to search the space of binding molecules much more efficiently and significantly outperforms all the previous best baselines in terms of the binding energy.
